title: Q-GROW-DEMO-DASHBOARD: GROW-2: a public read-only tenant-0 dashboard demo that shows what the system does
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** file:site/demo.js
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

Build /demo: the live record as a real dashboard (clocks, shipped-code chart by day and origin, backlog burn-down, system parts and drift) with plain-language captions, reading the same snapshot as /live. It is the demo that explains the product to a pilot applicant in under a minute. Read-only, no login.
Paths: site/demo.js, site/worker.js, site/site.test.mjs.
Acceptance: /demo renders from the snapshot with no external calls, is linked from /pilot, and has a test.
Metric moved: pilot_page_views_7d. Prediction: pilot page to application conversion is measurable within 14 days.

size: M

**Closing probe:** file:site/demo.js and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).
